description: Virtual Accelerator Digital Twin — Grafana 13 V2 dashboard resource schema

spec.title: Queue Depth
spec.description: Current number of pending items in the runner queue.

spec.title: THP Disabled
spec.description: Transparent Huge Pages status. Disabled is the expected state.

spec.title: Queue Wait p95
spec.description: 95th percentile time snapshots spend waiting in the runner queue.

spec.title: Memory Usage
spec.description: Resident, anonymous heap, and anonymous huge-page memory usage.

spec.title: Snapshot Cycle Rate
spec.description: Aggregate snapshot cycles processed per second.

spec.title: Snapshot Duration (p50/p95/p99)
spec.description: Snapshot processing latency at p50, p95, and p99.

spec.title: Queue Wait Duration (p50/p95/p99)
spec.description: Runner queue wait latency at p50, p95, and p99.

spec.title: Snapshot Duration Heatmap
spec.description: Distribution of snapshot processing duration over time.

spec.title: Queue Wait Heatmap
spec.description: Distribution of runner queue wait duration over time.

spec.title: Queue Wait avg
spec.description: Average runner queue wait duration over time.

spec.title: PV Total Posts
spec.description: Current cumulative post count for each PV.

spec.title: Logs
spec.description: Virtual Accelerator logs from Loki for the selected namespace.

title: Virtual Accelerator Digital Twin
